name: Buildkite Integration
description: Runs CI on a self-hosted Buildkite agent (native arm64) instead of a metered cloud fleet. genproj creates the pipeline, registers its GitHub webhook and triggers the first build — there is no manual "set up project" step. Requires Doppler: the build itself fetches secrets with doppler run.

queue.description: Buildkite agent queue the generated pipeline targets.

provisionPipeline.description: Create the pipeline, register its GitHub webhook and trigger the first build. Turn off to emit .buildkite/ config only.

branchGating.description: Run the heavy pipeline on main only. Set to false to run it on every branch.

ntfyNotifications.description: Send a notification when a deploy completes.

benefits: Owns the compute: builds run on your own hardware, natively arm64, with no per-minute metering
No manual setup — the pipeline and its GitHub webhook are provisioned during generation
Reuses a pipeline proven on ftn: path filtering, secret scanning, lockfile drift and JUnit annotation
Coexists with CircleCI, so a repo can migrate without a flag day

actions.description: genproj creates the pipeline in the Buildkite organisation (Default cluster) during generation
Registers the pipeline's GitHub webhook, without which pushes do not trigger builds, and triggers the first build
